correctness.rationale: Every nonzero real Birkhoff-orthogonal pair in l_3^2 reduces by signed-coordinate interchange to x=(1,t), y=±s(t²,-1), 0<=t<=1, s>=0. The noncompetitive branches are bounded by 2^(2/3) and explicit t=1/3,s=4/3 exceeds this bound. Interior stationarity yields E1(t,s)=0 and G(t,s)=0; exact resultant factors with degree-14 P(t³), Sturm gives precisely two roots in (0,1) and only the first admits s>t. Exact isolated t≈0.30927767737,s≈1.23472445472 yield μ≈1.72853813848209; independent numerical optimization corroborated not proved the global bound. Script was read and symbolic certificate structure checked against proof.
